meta.name: aed:back-to-top
meta.description: Master switch. Set content to 'on'/'true'/'1' to enable. Per-page opt-out: set data-aed-back-to-top='off' on the <html> element.

data-threshold.description: Scroll pixels before the button appears.

data-offset-x.description: CSS length, e.g. '1.5rem' — distance from the chosen edge.

data-offset-y.description: CSS length — distance from the bottom of the viewport.

data-size.description: Button diameter in px (string for CSS use).
